purpose: Evidence sources for the Skills dimension of the five 2026-10-03 default-off CLI additions (docs/sakullla-workflow/2026-10-03-new-cli-adapters-default-off) and the six 2026-10-07 additions (docs/sakullla-workflow/2026-10-07-新增客户端完整支持与用量统计修复). The shared Skills pipeline imports packages into each adapter's native discovery directory; these entries record where each directory contract comes from.

zcode.format: Shared resource root ~/.zcode/skills; ZCODE_DATA_BASE_DIR relocates the whole data root. Delivered with the desktop adapter.

qoder.format: ~/.qoder/skills discovery directory; QODER_CONFIG_DIR relocates the config root.

kimi_code.format: Skills directory under the KIMI_CODE_HOME data root; locally verified 0.31.1 install.

deepseek.format: Ranked .dsh/skills directories; DSH_HOME relocates the data root.

codebuddy.format: Skills directory under the CODEBUDDY_CONFIG_DIR root; npm @tencent-ai/codebuddy-code 2.161.1 verified locally.

mimo_code.format: Project .mimocode/skills and personal ~/.config/mimocode/skills ({skill,skills}/**/SKILL.md); the open-standard ~/.agents/skills the CLI also reads stays with the product. Delivered with the 2026-10-07 workflow.

cline.format: Brand root ~/.cline/skills plus the open-standard project .agents/skills directory. CLI not installed locally; directory contract from source.

devin.ref: devin --help and config/transcript layout inspection on 3000.11.3
devin.limitation: No Skills directory documented in official docs or the inspected layout; the skills dimension stays absent with the descriptor reason recorded.

command_code.evidence: local verified install (npm command-code) + shipped bundle
command_code.format: Personal ~/.commandcode/skills and project .commandcode/skills (SKILL.md frontmatter); the open-standard ~/.agents/skills the CLI also reads stays with the product.

antigravity.ref: agy --help (local 1.3.1); codeburn reverse engineering for the ~/.gemini layout
antigravity.format: Personal antigravity-cli/skills/<dir>/SKILL.md under ~/.gemini plus the open-standard project .agents/skills.

kiro.evidence: [RE] agentsview/threadle + official docs + local data root
kiro.ref: agentsview kiro.go / threadle; cli.kiro.dev docs; %LOCALAPPDATA%\kiro-cli inspected read-only
kiro.limitation: No Skills directory name appears in any evidence class; the skills dimension stays absent with the descriptor reason recorded.

acceptanceLimits: Directory contracts verified from official documentation or desktop sources; no live skill execution acceptance performed.
Windows development host only; macOS/Linux not exercised.
Skill package install/update/remove flows through the shared pipeline are covered by the existing synthetic fixtures, not per-CLI live samples.
The 2026-10-07 six were checked on Windows only; skills are delivered for mimo_code/cline/command_code/antigravity, while devin and kiro stay absent for lack of a documented directory contract.
